title: Construction and Validation of an Immune Cell Signature Score to Evaluate Prognosis and Therapeutic Efficacy in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
summary: Using gene-expression profiles from 1,447 HCC patients across TCGA, ICGC and GEO, the study quantified immune-cell signatures with ssGSEA and selected four signatures with Cox analyses and random-forest modeling to form ICSscore. The score stratified prognosis in TCGA and two independent cohorts and was associated with treatment-response datasets. These retrospective associations do not show treatment benefit.
ai_technology: Immune-cell signature score with Cox regression and XGBoost response classifier
organization: University of Shanghai for Science and Technology; Shanghai Institute for Biomedical and Pharmaceutical Technologies

evidence.tested: The ICSscore was developed from 1,447 HCC profiles and assessed for risk stratification across TCGA-LIHC and two independent cohorts; treatment-response associations were examined in HCC datasets and other cancer datasets.
evidence.unknown: The cohort and treatment-response analyses are retrospective; the reported associations do not establish prospective treatment selection or patient benefit.
evidence.ai_role: The study built an immune-cell signature score using multivariable Cox regression and used XGBoost to classify response associations in HCC datasets; these retrospective associations do not estimate treatment effects.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
